title: Aint Gnome Damn Way - A 2000's Flash Era Inspired animation clip What Learned
author: Trashy_io
selftext:
I started messing around with my 2D asset tool/WF trying to see if I could make gaming cutscenes with it and how to make it more efficient. 

**What I have learned:**

My tool/WF consists of building assets through canvas and JS procedural drawing methods that way it is easy to manually fix the common mistakes AI makes.

Through experimenting the best practices I have found is to make one character fully polished and then using that as your style anchor, not perfect but pretty gets it pretty close. And build out each asset as its own with their main animations included, then building the scene out.

The other issue I am running into is layering and placement issues, meaning when editing a scene something the character or scenes layers will get mixed up, or the AI will have a hard time understanding what to layer where and when. As well as placing say a pew pew in the hands of characters more often then not it will just be pretty off. 

The only way I have currently found around this is by putting in an editing tool either just a value box or a slider for placement and for layering I have not found a perfect fit that doesn't require more effort then doing it manually. 

If anyone has any suggestions id love to hear them! Layer or placement wise.
